products.name: GoodNews Daily Compendium Volume 1
description: The pursuit of God’s Word: unlocking spiritual riches through the GoodNews Daily Compendium. In the pursuit of a life deeply rooted in Christ, an unwavering dedication to God’s Word forms the cornerstone. The GoodNews Daily Compendium, Volume 1 provides an unparalleled resource for this journey, expertly organizing the gospel into thematic sections for enriched study and easy understanding.

This compendium serves as an indispensable resource for every believer’s spiritual growth. Its comprehensive collection of insightful articles is infused with divine wisdom, guiding readers to illuminate their paths, renew their dedication to scripture, and strengthen their relationship with God. For Christian leaders, this volume becomes a vital tool, aiding in the preparation of compelling Bible studies for fellowships and meetings. The all-encompassing Word-based teachings are captured in the following sections:
•⁠ ⁠Prosperity and Abundance •⁠ ⁠Keys to Divine Health •⁠ ⁠God-Kind of Faith •⁠ ⁠Being an Effective Soul Winner •⁠ ⁠Transformative Power of Prayer

The compendium not only offers profound teachings but also includes a user-friendly index, facilitating quick access to specific articles that address individual interests and spiritual needs. Each revelation and lesson contained within is meticulously written to bless and enrich the reader’s understanding through the Word of God, providing the spiritual nourishment necessary to navigate every season of life confidently.
•⁠ ⁠Prophet Uebert Angel

products.name: GoodNews Explorers Book (Volume 1)
description: Discover God’s Love, One Day At A Time! ‘Exploring God’s Word Every Day’ by Prophet Uebert Angel invites young hearts to dive into the Bible and find God’s love in their daily lives. Designed for children aged 3-12 years, this book brings Bible teachings to life with easy-to-understand stories, colorful illustrations, and memorable lessons. Each page encourages kids to learn about faith, kindness, and joy through God’s Word, making every day an opportunity to grow closer to Him. Perfect for family time, bedtime stories, or quiet moments of reflection, this book helps kids build a strong foundation of faith in a fun and engaging way.

products.name: GoodNews Explorers Book Easter Edition (Volume 2)
description: Discover The True Meaning of Easter Easter is the story of the greatest love ever shown! The True Meaning of Easter takes children on an exciting journey through the life, sacrifice, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. With simple storytelling and engaging Bible verses, this book helps young hearts understand why Jesus Christ came, what happened on the cross, and the victory of His resurrection. Perfect for children aged 3-12 years, it’s a wonderful resource for families, Sunday schools, and anyone wanting to share the good news of Easter in a fun and easy-to-understand way!

products.name: TAP2CONNECT WRISTBAND
description: Your Daily Devotional. One Tap Away.
Experience a new and effortless way to engage with the Word of God through the TAP2CONNECT NFC Wristband, an innovative product from the GoodNews Daily Store.
With a simple tap against your smartphone, your daily devotional opens instantly. No apps to download and no searching required. Just tap and connect.
Key Features
Instant Access Tap your wristband to your phone and access your daily GoodNews Daily devotional anytime, anywhere.
Automatic Time Zone Sync Wherever you are in the world, your devotional automatically aligns with your local time.
Audio Access Listen to the devotional instantly with integrated audio, allowing you to engage with the Word wherever you are.
Deeper Study Tools Explore further with one-tap access to scriptures, additional study content, and Bible challenges.
Seamless Experience No delays and no distractions. A simple and consistent way to remain connected to your daily devotional.
Designed for Everyday Living
More than a wristband, TAP2CONNECT is a practical and meaningful tool that keeps the Word of God within easy reach throughout your day.
